problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI Odom seq 10 full (1201 frames): 5 m S2S gate with ground without forward
problem.question: Does a 5 m S2S nearest-neighbour gate (s2s_gate_sq=25, the LOAM-family value) together with s2s_ground_no_forward change full-sequence accuracy with the fixed paper_odometry_plane_check setting?

variants.label: Paper odometry + plane check (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Fixed Table 6 setting (07-selected 0.17 deg correction and 0.05 m S2M plane check), rerun on the same binary as the candidate.
variants.note: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline (FEF, S2S Alg. 1 with re-association, S2M Alg. 2 with TVF map, DOR gating map insertion); no GT seed. intensity=on mapping=on dor=on mean pairs s2s=1469 s2m=2310 dor points/frame=110
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Close enough to the current default to keep as a live alternative.

variants.label: Paper odometry + plane check + 5 m S2S gate + S2S ground without forward (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same setting; S2S nearest-neighbour gate 5 m (s2s_gate_sq=25, the paper leaves it open; A-LOAM uses 25) and s2s_ground_no_forward=1. Opt-in; chosen on development sequences 01/02.
variants.command: build/evaluation/pcd_dogfooding dogfooding_results/kitti_seq_10_full experiments/reference_data/kitti_seq_10_full_gt.csv --methods inten_loam --summary-json experiments/results/runs/inten_loam_kitti_seq_10_full_s2s_gate_matrix/paper_odometry_plane_check_gate25_ground_no_forward/summary.json --no-gt-seed --inten-loam-paper-odometry --input-max-range-m 120 --input-vertical-angle-correction-deg 0.17 --inten-loam-paper-set s2m_plane_max_dist=0.05 --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_gate_sq=25 --inten-loam-paper-set s2s_ground_no_forward=1
variants.note: InTEn-LOAM paper pipeline (FEF, S2S Alg. 1 with re-association, S2M Alg. 2 with TVF map, DOR gating map insertion); no GT seed. intensity=on mapping=on dor=on mean pairs s2s=1732 s2m=2311 dor points/frame=109; S2S ground without forward information enabled (repository extension, opt-in)
variants.readability_note: Adds extra tuning knobs and therefore more command complexity.
variants.extensibility_note: Still stable-interface compatible, but with a larger parameter surface.
variants.decision_reason: Best combined benchmark score on the shared dataset and interface.
